name: pulumi
description: Pulumi Delivery (public preview): reads each Delivery run by number, one MaximizePM stage for each Delivery stage; the yes at a MaximizePM transition continues the Delivery gate; starts a run, retries it, cancels it. A roll back stays on Pulumi's page.

url.help: the Pulumi Cloud address, when not https://api.pulumi.com

ref.help: the number of the first Delivery run to read

token.help: a Pulumi access token of the organization

hosts: the Pulumi Cloud address of the setting url
